key_points: Evercore upgraded NTAP citing strong FY27 growth outlook.
Stock hit fresh record highs after upgrade, reflecting bullish momentum.
Analyst commentary suggests NTAP could become default storage landing zone in AWS cloud.
Recent insider selling of 5,000 shares by a director is minor relative to overall holdings.
Broad media coverage highlights NTAP's 147% six‑month gain, prompting buy‑side interest.
